practice.name: Beltsville Veterinary Hospital
practice.tagline: Modern veterinary care with a long-standing Beltsville history.
practice.description: Beltsville Veterinary Hospital provides compassionate wellness care, same-day sick visits, diagnostics, dental care, surgery, and boarding for dogs and cats in Beltsville, MD.
practice.serviceArea: Beltsville, College Park, Silver Spring, Laurel, and Prince George’s County, MD

team.name: Kathryn Fink
team.role: DVM, Medical Director and Part Owner
team.bio: Dr. Fink joined Beltsville Veterinary Hospital in 2004 after graduating from Michigan State University. She enjoys preventive medicine, long-term client relationships, walking local trails, reading, cooking, and baking.

team.name: Shawnne Spencer
team.bio: Dr. Spencer is a Maryland native and Virginia-Maryland Regional College of Veterinary Medicine graduate. He joined BVH in 2020 after practicing in Silver Spring and serves on the SPCA Humane Society of Prince George’s County medical advisory board.

team.name: Marjorie Farris
team.bio: Dr. Margie Farris joined the Beltsville team part-time in 2020. She focuses on preventive medicine and helping pets stay happy and healthy for as long as possible.
